notes.title: Game the game on Android
notes.content:
The game is free with no IAP no Ads and no internet connection needed on google play.

100% free.

Go grab it!

notes.title: Game will be free
notes.content:
The game is free on Google Play right now. No ads or IAP no nothing. 

So I'm going to make the game free here too. It is only fair.

Drop me a donation if you liked the game. 

Thank you everyone for playing the game all these years. Its been nice to know people enjoyed the game. I put over 2 years of full time work into it.

If donations start coming in maybe I'll put some more work into the game. We will see. I have big plans for new games on steam over the next year or so. 

I love making games. Thank you all.

notes.title: Update Version 1.2.2
notes.content:
All reported bugs have been fixed.

Stability issues have been resolved.

GUI has been improved.

Army Tokens have been upgraded. They now show the faction type of the army.

Any other improvements that players want post here. I look forward to chatting and getting ideas from you guys.
